messages:
maria: planning Emberlane private rollout tonight 02:00-03:30 PST. Target image rwinf/serve:2026-03-18 + model pin redwood/llama-2-70b-quant-v2@sha256:abcd1234 -> deploying v2.8.1-quant. Need eng-releases sign-off and oncall coverage. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/emberlane-2.8.1 (short: latency optimizations + quant profile q4_0.2).

maria: TL;DR rollout plan: canary 5% (10m) -> 20% (15m) -> 100% (30m). Rollback: immediate pin back to v2.8.0 + traffic shift to emberlane-canary slice + revert routing if KPIs breach. Runbook: https://runbooks/emberlane-rollout

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for 2026-03-21 02:00 PST by maria. Canary slice: emberlane-canary. Steps: ```
1) canary 5% for 10m
2) ramp 20% for 15m
3) ramp 100% for 30m
4) verify post-roll metrics for 15m
```

sam: I'm oncall for the window. two quick questions: 1) what are exact abort thresholds? 2) do we have an automatic rollback or manual only?

maria: abort thresholds: p50 > 250ms OR error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR GPU OOM on >1 node. We do NOT have auto-rollback — ops-bot will open an incident and we manually shift traffic or pin back. If underlying infra issue (OOM/driver crash) there's an automatic fallback to hosted-compat model for customer traffic.

ops-bot: will open incident if error_rate > 0.5% for 5m or p50 > 250ms for 10m. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall + pager.

eli: ran extended canary yesterday against a snapshot of Emberlane traffic. numbers: p50 95ms, p95 270ms, p99 420ms, error_rate 0.08%. CPU peaked 78% on serve nodes. Suggest we relax p99 window to 600ms for the first 30m of ramp, but keep p50/p95 strict. Also confirm we pinned quant profile q4_0.2 to avoid runtime jitter.

neil: no DB/schema changes, right? this is model image swap only?

maria: correct — model binary only, no migrations, no config flips. We'll keep read replicas in place; no write schema work.

june: infra +1. I'll reserve 2 spare GPU nodes in the same AZ to absorb failover traffic if needed. Also will watch memory growth; if we see >85% memory on more than 1 node we should stop the ramp.

sam: thanks. given eli + june checks, i'm good to cover the window. I'll be online for the full duration. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — final ask: please ack here if you approve the pinned runtime image + rollback plan.

eli: ack.

june: ack.

sam: ack and available.

deploy-bot: Rollout started 2026-03-21 02:00:00 PST — canary 5% (emberlane-canary).

sam: starting canary verification now — running smoke and sample-slo checks.

ops-bot: smoke checks passed. metrics snapshot: p50 100ms, p95 285ms, p99 510ms, error_rate 0.10%. GPU mem avg 72%.

maria: holding at 5% for full 10m to watch 99p and mem.

deploy-bot: ramping to 20% at 02:11 PST.

eli: post-ramp 20%: p50 102ms, p95 290ms, p99 520ms, error_rate 0.12%. memory trending up but under 80%. still nominal.

sam: looks safe to continue to full ramp.

maria: proceed to 100%. I'm staying pinned on the thread and will start post-roll verification window.

deploy-bot: ramping to 100% at 02:30 PST.

ops-bot: monitoring: error_rate 0.09%, p50 105ms, p95 295ms, p99 530ms. no OOM.

neil: confirming no leftover tasks on deployment hosts. all clear.

sam: all checks green from oncall. go/no-go = go.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed 2026-03-21 03:15 PST. release tag: emberlane-v2.8.1-deployed.

maria: excellent — will publish short release note + postmortem template in #releases after 24h. if any regressions surface, escalate to the incident channel and we'll trigger the rollback plan. thanks everyone for the quick review and coverage.

eli: noted — will run a scheduled eval job against live traffic overnight and post results in morning.

sam: signed off. night shift oncall standing by. :coffee:
